analysis.session_summary: Japan verbal intervention signals from PM Takaichi and FinMin Katayama drove early JPY strength, but the attempt was rejected with JPY giving back 62% of its peak gain. USD closed weaker even though Revised UoM Consumer Sentiment beat forecasts and produced a brief 0.047% USD lift. NZD closed at its best while CHF was the weakest major, and Iran/US headlines whipsawed risk across the window.

themes.evidence: Top headlines: PM Takaichi and FinMin Katayama on weak yen; JPY strength_pct 0.258 but intraday peak 0.656, gave back 62%.

themes.theme: Data and central bank signals failed to anchor USD/GBP
themes.evidence: Revised UoM beat actual 48.1 vs forecast 47.4 produced USD stronger 0.047%; Bailey speech muted basket -0.014%.
Iran-US talks, Trump opposing ceasefire, and Senior Iranian Official headlines whipsawed risk; Brent/USD closed +0.877% and CHF strength_pct -0.207.

currency_drivers.USD: UoM beat caused brief USD strength but broad softening dominated the full window.
currency_drivers.EUR: No euro-area catalyst; held range with slight drift lower and no clear driver.
currency_drivers.JPY: Japan verbal intervention signals sparked leading strength before fading; no data releases.
currency_drivers.GBP: Bailey speech was muted; no clear domestic catalyst, GBP held its range.
currency_drivers.AUD: No domestic catalyst; early selling rejected and recovered, likely risk appetite support.
currency_drivers.CAD: No Canadian catalyst; softened with USD and oil price swings.
currency_drivers.CHF: No Swiss catalyst; weakest major, likely used as funding in risk-on rotation.
currency_drivers.NZD: No NZ-specific catalyst; closed at best on broad USD softness and risk appetite.

leg_notes.EUR/USD: EUR/USD's five legs (up 34.5, down 18.3, up 10.6, down 24.2, up 10.4) netted +16 pips with no leg owning a single catalyst.

polarity_reads.read: Normal reaction: USD strengthened on the beat, implying no contrarian positioning against positive US data surprises despite broad USD softness.
Muted reaction inside noise floor implies markets assigned no directional impulse to Bailey's remarks.

scenarios.name: Risk-on consolidation
scenarios.thesis: US-China trade goodwill and Iran talks hold, keeping USD soft and commodity FX supported; Japan verbal intervention fades.
triggers: China-US trade and investment councils headline holds
scenarios.invalidation: Trump or Iranian officials escalate rhetoric.

pair_paths.rationale: EUR/USD closed +16 pips; sustained USD softness extends modest gain.
NZD/USD closed +19.6 pips and at best; risk appetite supports further upside.

scenarios.name: Yen rebound resumes
scenarios.thesis: Japanese officials reiterate intervention warnings; USD/JPY retests lower toward range low.
triggers: Japanese FinMin/PM repeat strong yen language
scenarios.invalidation: No further yen commentary and US yields climb.

pair_paths.rationale: USD/JPY closed down 65.6 pips; intervention fear could extend the drop.
CHF/JPY fell 88.7 pips; yen strength dominates if intervention theme returns.

scenarios.name: Geopolitical risk repricing
scenarios.thesis: Iran/US tensions reassert, oil spikes, safe-haven CHF/JPY bid, commodity currencies weaken.

pair_paths.rationale: USD/CHF had a down leg of 19.7 pips; safe-haven CHF appreciation drives USD/CHF lower.
AUD/USD down leg of 30.4 pips in prior risk-off reflects commodity FX weakness.

risks.why_it_matters: JPY strength peaked at +0.656% but gave back 62%; renewed comments could cause sharp yen moves.
UoM beat caused only 0.047% USD lift; if soft USD persists, data may not support dollar.
Brent/USD closed +0.877% with Iran/US headlines; an escalation can reverse risk trades quickly.

analysis.calendar_ahead_note: ECB President Lagarde Speaks at 15:30 can change EUR; otherwise the window has no other scheduled high-impact releases.
